limits: Finds the markers; it does not check that what they name exists.
bio.jane/contract.noReading: A lookup of the notebook's own links between entries and records, listed as stored; nothing is inferred.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which plasmids, actions and gels does a notebook entry refer to?

description: Extract @plasmid / !action / &gel cross-references from a lab-notebook markdown body.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

name: notebook_cross_refs
